_comment: Batch 3 — Fresno. Ingested 2026-08-04 from the ChatGPT Work nine-stage workbook (generation A: Import Ready / Venues / Evidence). NOT YET IMPORTED.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Fresno, CA MSA COUNTY LIST (Fresno), not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the MSA counties [Fresno County, California (relation/396492)], rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg.
_expected_publish_comment: Generated from this metro's own --stage=project output on 2026-08-04, then asserted by both project and publish. Any row that classifies differently from this block FAILS the run rather than reporting a plausible-looking number. Regenerate it deliberately if the split is meant to change; never edit it to make a run pass.
_expected_publish_history: 2026-08-06 wave-3 release: re-authored 11 -> 17 publish. The prior block was locked before ADR-16 (coordinate precision 'low' no longer holds a row; it publishes behind an approximate-location label) and ADR-17 (access_type 'unknown' and candidate research_status 'probable' are no longer gate conditions; only duplicate/not_venue/not_pickleball/held block). Every divergence is accounted for by those two ADRs plus the wave-3 audit holds recorded in facility_candidates.reviewer_notes. Not nudged to fit output.
